name: Selena Steinberg
text: I am a Ph.D. candidate in the Learning Sciences program at Indiana University. My research considers how we might reimagine STEM education through arts-based, play-based, and embodied approaches in order to foster more joyful and positive experiences for all youth. I am passionate about centering youth and community voices in research towards not only creating pathways into STEM for all students, but transforming STEM education itself so that it becomes a more welcoming and equitable space.
